description: This file defines the IStateControl interface within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace. It provides methods for controlling and monitoring the state of a remote object, including commands like suspend and resume, and states such as uninitialized, suspended, resumed, and exited. It also includes a nested notification interface for state change events.

classes.name: IStateControl
classes.description: Interface for controlling and monitoring the state of a remote object, including commands, states, and notification registration.

classes.name: IStateControl::INotification
classes.description: Interface for receiving notifications about state changes.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts a state or command enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the state control with the provided framework.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Returns the current state of the object.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for state changes.
